question: A project owner is adding a newly issued reference document to a project's knowledge base. Which sequence of steps is correct?
options: A) Confirm it is the approved current version; upload it to project knowledge; record a review date; ask a test question.
B) Upload it to project knowledge; confirm it is the approved current version; ask a test question; record a review date.
C) Ask a test question; upload it to project knowledge; record a review date; confirm it is the approved current version.
D) Record a review date; ask a test question; confirm it is the approved current version; upload it to project knowledge.
correct_answers: A) Confirm it is the approved current version; upload it to project knowledge; record a review date; ask a test question.
explanations: Correct. Verify currency before it becomes a source, then schedule the next review and confirm it answers correctly.
The document becomes a live source before anyone has checked that it is the current version.
The test happens before the document exists in the project, and currency is checked last.
A review date is set for a document that has not been added, and the upload comes last.
